name: gather_wood
description: Cut three nearby trees to obtain at least 30 Wood.
task: Hold at least 30 Wood (any kind: Wood, BorealWood, PalmWood...).

name: obtain_workbench
description: Gather wood from nearby trees and craft a WorkBench.
task: Hold a work bench (any wood variant counts, e.g. BorealWoodWorkBench).

name: get_wooden_hammer
description: Obtain a wooden hammer by gathering wood, building a workbench, then crafting the hammer.
task: Hold a wooden hammer (any wood variant counts).

name: gather_stone_blocks
description: Mine 30 Stone blocks using the existing Copper Pickaxe.

name: obtain_chair_and_table_v2
description: Collects additional wood, then crafts a wooden chair and a wooden table.
task: Hold a wooden chair and a wooden table (any wood variant counts).

name: obtain_wooden_door
description: Collects wood, builds a workbench if needed, then crafts one WoodenDoor.
task: Hold a wooden door (any wood variant counts).

name: cut_one_tree_for_wood
description: Mines the closest tree to add at least 5 more Wood, reaching a total of 30.
task: Hold at least 30 Wood (any kind: Wood, BorealWood, PalmWood...).

name: hold_furnace_with_stone
description: Obtain a Furnace by mining StoneBlocks and crafting it with an existing WorkBench.
